summary: DRDGOLD Limited filed a Form 6-K containing its reviewed condensed consolidated financial statements for the fiscal year ended 30 June 2026 and a final cash dividend declaration of 120 SA cents per share (net 96 SA cents after 20% withholding tax), up from 40 SA cents prior year. Revenue rose 42% to R11.159 billion; operating profit rose 83% to R6.452 billion. No strategic transaction is announced; this is a routine periodic results and dividend disclosure. Key dates: ex-dividend 9 September 2026, record 11 September, payment 14 September 2026. Watch only for gold-price driven operational trends, not event risk.
